C1050.title: College Student Followed a Female Student into Dormitory and Attacked with a Knife
C1050.summary: At 22:57 on September 10, 2023, Nanning Qingxiu police received a report that a man carrying a knife had entered a female dormitory at a college on Wuhe Avenue in Guangxi. Police found that the 21-year-old suspect Liu followed Liu Yue into the dormitory over a relationship dispute and wounded her roommate Zhao with a sharp weapon. He was controlled at the scene and placed in criminal detention; the victim was not in life-threatening danger.
